title: Website Policies
section: UIDAI does not sell or share any personally identifiable information provided on the Platforms to any third party (public/private), except as required under applicable laws.     All information will be protected against loss, misuse, unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. **REASONABLE SECURITY PRACTICES**      Reasonable security measures such as administrative, technical, operational, and physical controls have been implemented to ensure the security of personal information. H. USER CHOICES Users may choose not to avail certain services that require personal information. However, this may limit access to specific functionalities of the portals. J. CHILDREN & MINOR’S PRIVACY UIDAI is committed to protecting the privacy of children and minors. Parents and guardians are encouraged to supervise the online activities of minors. K. CONTACT FOR QUERIES    Web Information Manager   Email: webadmin[-]uidai[@]nic[.]in Hyperlinking Policy Links to external websites/portals At many places in this website **and associated portals (including myAadhaar)** , you shall find links to other websites/portals. The links have been placed for your convenience. UIDAI is not responsible for the contents and reliability of the linked websites and does not necessarily endorse the views expressed in them. Mere presence of the link or its listing on this **website or associated portals** should not be assumed as endorsement of any kind. We cannot guarantee that these links will work all the time and we have no control over availability of linked pages. When you select a link to an outside website, you are leaving the UIDAI website **or associated portals** and are subject to the privacy and security policies of the owners/sponsors of the outside website. UIDAI cannot authorize the use of copyrighted materials contained in linked websites. Users are advised to request such authorization from the owner of the linked website. UIDAI does not guarantee that linked websites comply with Indian Government Web Guidelines. Links to UIDAI website by other websites We do not object to you linking directly to the information that is hosted on this site **or associated portals** and no prior permission is required for the same. However, we would like you to inform us about any links provided to this Portal **website or associated portals** so that you can be informed of any changes or updations **updates** therein. Also, we do not permit our pages to be loaded into frames on your site. The pages belonging to this site must load into a newly opened browser window of the User.
